## Kanienkeha.net

![](images/moh-logo.gif)
![](images/owl.gif)
![](images/active-noise.png)
![](images/active-noise.png)

Kanienkeha.net is an open source initiative dedicated to the endangered Kanienkeha (Mohawk) language. It publishes new content every week and relies on small donations to keep going. Supporters can give through Patreon: http://patreon.com/mohdictionary

Visitors can try sample searches: apple, colors, numbers.

Site name on the web: kanienkeha.net. Developed by Doolittle Productions (http://doolittleproductions.com/).

![](images/3green.png)
![](images/4green.png)
![](images/2green.png)

![](images/notes.jpg)

## Site statistics

![](images/forum-stats1.png)

- Words: 2650
- Categories: 159 (https://kanienkeha.net/sitemap/)
- Tags: 260
- Blog posts: 10 (http://blog.kanienkeha.net/)

## Welcome message from the founder

![](images/love1.png)

Greeting: She:kon (hello). The site was built so the community can develop online resources for the Kanienkeha language. With contributions from visitors and elders, the aim is a digital inventory of the language, along with discussion of the cultural meaning behind each word. If the dictionary reaches roughly 10,000 words, the project moves to a next phase: building a Google-style translator with audio to help with pronunciation.

Closing: Nia:wen (thank you). Signed Benjamin Doolittle.

detail: building website from brief.md and images/; mid-write

content.text:
I've built the site as a single static page, `index.html`, in the project folder next to `brief.md`. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It uses a green palette to match the logo and works on phone screens. From top to bottom it has:
- **Header:** the logo, an English / Kanienkeha language switcher and the full navigation bar from the brief.
- **Hero:** the project summary, a Patreon button and the sample searches (apple, colors, numbers).
- **Founder's welcome:** Benjamin Doolittle's message, with the longhouse and "we are friends" images.
- **Site statistics:** 2,650 words, 159 categories, 260 tags and 10 blog posts.
- **Most recent entries:** the phrase, the ten daily-routine commands and all the occupations, each linking to its page, plus the page 1–4 / Next / Last pager.
- **Map, blog, word of the day, notes upload and social links:** these use the map, protest-sign, notes and small icon images.
- **Footer:** the footer links and the Doolittle Productions credit.

All links point to the live kanienkeha.net URLs from the brief. A few details to know:
- **Language switcher:** the English and Kanienkeha buttons don't link anywhere, since the brief gave no URLs.
- **Sample searches:** they link to the home page for the same reason.
- **Duplicate image:** `active-noise.png` appears twice in the brief, so I used it once, as the page background texture.
- **Unused file:** the `favicons` file in `images/` isn't used. `favicon.ico` is the page icon.
